summary: Review-required audit trail for the live thumbnail-cache cleanup card. The app already ships this file-backed cleanup action and the repo cleanup docs describe the Explorer thumbnail-cache files, but the card has not yet been promoted into the validated research-provider surface.

setting.name: Clear Thumbnail Cache
setting.casual_explanation: This clears Explorer thumbnail-cache database files so thumbnails are rebuilt later.
setting.why_people_change_it: People clear thumbnail caches when they are troubleshooting stale or corrupted Explorer thumbnails or reclaiming a small amount of disk space.
setting.tradeoffs_overview: Clearing the cache removes existing thumbnail databases, and Explorer rebuilds them later as folders are browsed again.
setting.professional_notes: The current app enumerates thumbcache_*.db files under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\Windows\Explorer and deletes them as a one-shot cleanup action. Repo cleanup docs identify the same thumbnail-cache family.
